fields.diagnosis: Community-acquired bacterial pneumonia and mild acute hypoxemia.
fields.canonical_diagnosis: Community-acquired bacterial pneumonia and mild acute hypoxemia.
fields.procedures: Serial chest radiography (X-ray), sputum microbiology culture, and intravenous antibiotic therapy.
fields.follow_up: Complete the prescribed oral antibiotic course. Repeat chest X-ray in 4 weeks and visit primary care physician in 2 weeks.
